purpose: Large external asset/content pipeline without bloating Git history
rules: Never commit filler bytes just to increase project size.
Every external asset pack must record provenance and license.
Git stores source/code/manifests; large binary packs belong in the external content workspace.
Android builds consume only the optimized packs required by the selected release profile.
